dequant_layout_audit.interpretation: All tested final raw logits are already constant all-zero. Official dequant, scalar scale, zero-point handling, uint16 reinterpretation, and endian swap cannot recover nonzero logits. Late hidden states are nonzero and often saturated, so the current failure is upstream of output dequant and at or before final segment execution/output emission.
